title: C1 Lineage and Disabled Console Adapter Acceptance
completed_work: Implemented exact Discovery and Development C1 source-bound lineage adapters.
Implemented exact formula evidence cards and separate downstream child-reference traces.
Implemented the permanent C2 and Pattern Discovery authority-unchanged banner.
Implemented a disabled candidate-only Console projection with explicit stale and missing-trace states.
Implemented recursive no-write, Validation-denial, mixed-panel and route-activation guards.
Added four fail-closed schemas, fixture, projection registry, tests and evidence runner.

acceptance_conditions.condition: Exact C1 source release and manifest binding
Fact and downstream trace are separate panels
Permanent downstream authority banner is exact
C2 and Pattern Discovery authority remain unchanged
Validation is denied before path, object or record resolution
C1 null and C2 transition compact co-render is rejected
Downstream scoring, severity, tuning and recommendation vocabulary is rejected
Route activation before RC-G4 is rejected

tests.scope: 12 focused lineage and adapter tests, exact evidence generation, 70-test complete repository suite and authority assertions

warnings: The gate accepts adapter capability only and does not enable the live Console route.
Downstream references are identity-only traces and are not defect, tuning, candidate-quality or remediation signals.
Validation remains locked and unavailable before path, object or record resolution.

grants: Create deterministic local read-only lineage and projection objects.
Prepare, but do not activate, the C1 Console projection candidate.
Prepare one consolidated operator-required RC-G4 decision packet.
does_not_grant: C2 or Pattern Discovery authority change
Semantic, threshold, model, family, candidate or theory promotion
Probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent write

rollback: Revert only the bounded RO3-WP4 adapter implementation, schemas, fixture, registry, evidence, gate packet and delegated decision through a new non-destructive commit. Preserve RO3-G0 contracts, RO3-G3 assurance evidence, C1 releases and selectors, and all downstream evidence.
